title: Urban Building 3D Environment Asset
author: Haman24
selftext:
I wanted to take a break from the Manors and Cathedrals and make an ordinary building. For an environmental asset I think this is pretty good although it is a bit rough around the edges (and dont mind the music I forgot I was listening to the shrek soundtrack when I was recording lol) let me know what you think

  
Made with Rapid Assets- Shown in Blender

comments.author: EasyTarget973
comments.body: You can get your AI to write a simple wrapper for ComfyUI and run better generations locally, if you have a decent video card.

replies.author: Haman24
replies.body: o thats cool I didnt know about that

comments.author: Limp-Caterpillar8661
comments.body: I need to learn how to do this. My buildings are all plain blocks (only using headless blender)

replies.author: Haman24
replies.body: The website I used to make this has a blender plugin aswell, I personally haven't used it yet I just import the generations from the website to blender but you can check it out and experiment with it maybe it'll help, let me know how it goes

comments.author: Lief3D
comments.body: What a gross wireframe. I'd hate to see the unwrap/material useage. The details make it seem like its meant to be tiny, otherwise you're going to see all the weird grossness like how one of the poles is just half there. This would not work well in a game.
